description: This file configures the Angular application's providers, including zone change detection, routing, hydration, and HTTP client.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Enables change detection strategies within Angular zones with specific event coalescing options.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Configures routing for the Angular application with the provided routes.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Enables hydration features to improve server-side rendering performance.

methods.name: withEventReplay
methods.description: Configures hydration to replay previous events.

methods.name: provideHttpClient
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP client module for making HTTP requests in Angular.
